entities.summary: Ryan Edwin Diem is an American former professional football player who spent his entire 11-year career as an offensive lineman for the Indianapolis Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Northern Illinois Huskies, and was selected by the Colts in the fourth round of the 2001 NFL draft. Diem played for the Colts from 2001 to 2011 and was part of the Super Bowl XLI championship team that beat the Chicago Bears.
